representations.name: joint leaf profile map
representations.new_information: Records Psi(j)=(phi_j,alpha_j) after one fixed associate section rather than treating four product rows independently.
representations.first_test: Use alpha_j+phi_j=T and compare fibres of Psi with fibres of phi.

representations.name: exact profile-fibre partition
representations.new_information: Stores the exact equality #Psi(J)=#phi(J) and identical fibre sizes.
representations.repairs_loss: replaces qualitative conditioning language by a literal counting interface
representations.first_test: Prove both projections between Psi(J) and phi(J) are inverse on the fixed-total affine graph.

representations.name: ordered-group valuation section
representations.new_information: Fixes a translation-invariant total order on Gamma and normalizes every Laurent polynomial by its least support exponent.
representations.repairs_loss: makes every absolute unit coordinate well-defined and multiplicative
representations.first_test: Prove v(PQ)=v(P)+v(Q) in the ordered group ring.

representations.name: section-change cocycle ledger
representations.new_information: Tracks how independently changing representatives of distinct associate classes translates phi_j and alpha_j while preserving their sum.
representations.repairs_loss: separates normalization entropy from geometric information
representations.first_test: Choose P_{lambda_j X} itself as section and compare with least-exponent normalization.

representations.name: same-sign scalar valuation orbit
representations.new_information: On one sign class, expresses phi_j as lambda_j times a fixed nonzero extremal exponent of X.
representations.repairs_loss: retains the monomial translation discarded by normalized divisor shapes
representations.first_test: Use distinct same-sign lambda_j to test injectivity.

representations.name: natural-order endpoint dichotomy
representations.new_information: Keeps the natural real order fixed and distinguishes whether the endpoint used by the selected sign class is zero or nonzero.
representations.repairs_loss: prevents normalization changes from being used to manufacture an unconditional scalar orbit
representations.first_test: Prove range one at a zero endpoint and injectivity at a nonzero endpoint without reversing the order.

representations.name: power-large exponent ledger
representations.new_information: Compares |J_sigma|>=K/2=t^(5/9-o(1)) with the number and maximum fibre size of complete profiles.
representations.repairs_loss: quantifies the exact mass lost by conditioning
representations.first_test: Insert injective phi on J_sigma and compute retained fibre size one.

representations.name: subpower-range adversarial comparator
representations.new_information: Tests any t^o(1) profile-range claim against the already legal power-large same-sign block.
representations.repairs_loss: prevents primitive-kernel uniqueness from being misread as profile compression
representations.first_test: Kill if the ordered normalization has |Psi(J_sigma)|=|J_sigma|.

representations.name: gauge-invariant normalized-shape quotient
representations.new_information: Deletes raw monomial units and retains only normalized associate classes and divisor incidence.
representations.repairs_loss: identifies what remains meaningful after arbitrary section change
representations.first_test: Check whether the quotient still determines an absolute product-unit fibre.

representations.name: all-target nonpromotion firewall
representations.new_information: Separates the local range obstruction from target-pair occurrence, collision fibres and outer stability.
representations.repairs_loss: blocks a local profile theorem from becoming a public exponent claim
representations.first_test: Demand same-domain t^(28/9-o(1)) occurrence and fibre below t^(1/9-epsilon).
